p: This lake stretches from the Khalpar of Sector 12 through Sectors 15 and 17 up to Mirpur DOHS. Its rural environment makes it one of the most popular attractions in Uttara.

This is an area located in Sector 17. To its south are official buildings of various universities and institutions. Many visitors come to see these aesthetic buildings in a semi-rural setting. The area also has several restaurants.
Established in 2023, this Hindu temple is not very ornate, but it is beautifully decorated during festivals. Those occasions are the best time to visit.
